xmldoc.short_description: Run an agentic assistant loop that can call Nelson tools.

param_input_item.param_description: string scalar or character vector: the task described in plain language.
scalar struct from nelson.ai.options; an optional MaxSteps field limits the number of tool steps.

param_output_item.param_description: character vector: the final assistant answer.
character vector: the full exchange, including tool results.

description.p: nelson.ai.agent drives an agentic loop: the model may request Nelson tools, which are run in the live session with nelson.ai.mcp.call, and the results are fed back until a final answer is produced.
It requires an AI provider reachable through nelson.ai.options and nelson.ai.ask, for example a local Ollama server or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
The model requests a tool by replying with a JSON object {"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {...}}, and ends by replying with plain text.

example_item.example_item_description: Requires a configured provider (for example a local Ollama server).
